Rockstar has not published an official list; where a how-to detail comes from a guide site rather than the game, the guide says so.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Earn the other 54 trophies. Finish the story first, then work the 100% checklist — A Long Road is the last big gate. Expect around 200 hours; nothing here needs online play and there are no difficulty trophies.
sources: PSN list via Exophase / Push Square

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion. The checklist appears under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story, but work done earlier still counts. The big numbers: 300 stunts, 70 of 80 Challenges, 200 of 277 vehicles discovered, all 39 illegal operations and all 8 bank vaults. Nothing on the checklist is missable.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida (18 spots). Meditation spots show as purple icons when you are close; meditating at a spot with your partner counts it for both characters, so bring your partner every time. MISSABLE: Lucia's balcony meditation in Chapter 1 disappears once the chapter ends — after she is home, check the kitchen in the morning (the morning after the mission Down to Earth is the usual time), follow her out to the balcony of Jason's house and accept the task. Keep a Chapter 1 save until this trophy pops.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA: steal a large passenger plane docked at a boarding bridge — the planes at gates E3 and E4 work; planes parked elsewhere on the airfield do not count. Get to the cockpit, back out toward the runway and take off, then fly about 1 km away from the airport before it pops. Save first — the police come fast.

Bring Sticky Bombs and take all three key valuables: the luxury watch in an office, the shotgun on a table, and the contents of the office safe, which you blow open with a Sticky Bomb.
